tasks.short: Provide guests information about local shopping, dining and recreation.

steps.what: Clarify the guest's interests, timing, budget and practical constraints
Filter the maintained local guide for relevant venues and current verified details
Provide local information and discuss which options suit this guest
Prepare the guest's local-information card using selected verified guide fields
Check the final information card, freshness and intended guest recipient
Send the approved information card to the guest

tasks.design: Configure a searchable native local guide in {DOCS} and an exact-field information-card template. Keep guest conversation and recommendations human; the concierge chooses and checks the actual final card before a separate {CHAT} send. No model invents venues, prices or hours, and no new guide is assumed free.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guest preferences are conversational and local details change.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained guide can support filters and exact-field cards without generated recommendations.
tasks.still_hard: Fit, local nuance and stale information require a concierge.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the guest and explain the practical difference between options.
tasks.altitude: Less lookup navigation and repeated fact copying, with conversation retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a staff-maintained local guide can support deterministic filters and fact cards without a conversational model.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a desk conversation with a requested follow-up card. Confirm actual lookup/copy/send work; existing native actions earn no new benefit.

s1 concierge captures category, date, budget and practical constraints. Staff already maintain venue_id, name, location, category, price_note, opening_note, source_reference and checked_at; guide upkeep is explicitly charged below. Missing/stale details require manual venue confirmation in retained s2/s5 time or omission with explanation.

s2 retains option reading and s4 retains selection and personal wording. Native search/templates precede custom code. If no maintained guide exists, count its creation separately before any adoption; the estimate does not assume free source capture.
a1 binds the actual complete card and guest contact after s5; edits revoke approval. No booking, price guarantee or separate message is implied.
research_questions: Can the existing guide support current guest answers after all source-checking and upkeep are counted?

incremental.description: Keep local-guide facts and source-check dates current

approvals.approved_version: s5 final verified information card and guest recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 10 lookup, 5 card-copy and 5 send hours minus 2 guide upkeep = 18. Low halves lookup benefit and keeps other actions manual: 5 minus 2 = 3. Guest conversation stays full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm the guest's destination, origin, travel mode and route constraints
Prepare a route using the existing map application's native directions
outputs: candidate guest route and map link

steps.what: Check the actual route, landmarks, map link and intended recipient
inputs: candidate guest route and map link

steps.what: Provide directions and check that the guest understands the route
Send the checked route link to the guest's confirmed contact

tasks.design: Use native directions in {OTHER}, the existing map application, rather than a language model. The concierge confirms exact endpoints, mode and practical restrictions, checks the complete route/link, explains it and authorises a separate {CHAT} link send. A changed route after conversation needs a new check before delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: A correct address may still produce an unsuitable entrance or travel route.
tasks.enabler_now: Native map routes and share links can avoid manually reconstructing directions.
tasks.still_hard: Practical access, guest understanding and local disruptions require a person.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when an apparently short route is unsuitable for this guest.
tasks.altitude: Less route transcription and link handling, with explanation retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: map applications provide native routes and share links; route suitability still needs checking.

assumptions: Provisional shares apply where staff still reconstruct a route and manually transfer it into guest messages. Existing native route/share use earns no new saving; no travel-time benefit is claimed.

s1 concierge captures exact_origin, destination/entrance, mode, requested_time and volunteered practical constraint. Map provider supplies route geometry/directions; desk staff supply only actually known restriction/location/check_date notes. Input capture and local validation remain full time; missing route/access information is checked manually.
s2 retains 12 hours for route/entrance selection and labels. Native settings are tried before code. A route is not advertised as accessible unless its actual constraints are verified.
a1 binds the final route link, travel mode and guest contact after s3. If s4 changes a detail, return to s3. No booking, background guest location collection or automatic follow-up is introduced.
research_questions: Does the native share route remove a real manual transfer while preserving entrance and travel-mode checks?

incremental.description: Check standard route origins and known local restriction notes

approvals.approved_version: s3 final route link, mode and confirmed guest recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 8 route preparation and 10 message-transfer hours minus 1 upkeep = 17. Low halves preparation benefit and keeps send manual: 4 minus 1 = 3. All guest conversation and route checks retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify flower preferences, recipient, delivery timing and spending limit
Check florist catalogue availability, prices and delivery conditions
Prepare the exact flower order from the selected quote and guest details
Check the final order, total price, card message and recipient details
Approve the actual final flower order and total spending commitment
Submit the guest-approved flower order to the selected florist
Verify the florist's actual acceptance and resolve any substitution or timing issue
Write the guest's order confirmation using the actual florist status
Check the complete guest confirmation and intended recipient
Send the approved flower-order confirmation to the guest
Write and check the flower request's final service-log entry
Commit the checked flower service-log entry

tasks.design: Use the florist's existing {PARTNER_PORTAL} catalogue and order form before custom integration. Reuse confirmed guest fields in a native {HELPDESK} request. The guest approves the actual complete priced order before submission. Verify the florist's real response, then separately approve/send the guest confirmation and approve/commit the desk record. No model selects substitutions or spends money.
tasks.previous_blocker: A guest preference, a priced order and an accepted florist order are different states.
tasks.enabler_now: A native portal can expose current options and accept a precisely approved order.
tasks.still_hard: Taste, card wording, recipient privacy and substitutions require personal handling.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the occasion and resolve a disappointing option without misrepresenting availability.
tasks.altitude: Less catalogue navigation and approved order/message transfer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an existing florist catalogue/order portal may support exact-field order transfer; actual partner capability is unverified.

assumptions: Shares are provisional with 90 concierge and 10 guest units; only concierge work enters savings. Existing portal use earns no new benefit. The scenario uses an already agreed settlement route, with no new payment or room-charge automation credited.

s1 concierge captures product_preferences, budget, recipient_name, delivery_address, delivery_window and card_text. Florist supplies product_id, current_availability, item_price, delivery_fee, substitution_terms and quote_expiry. s2 retains availability/price interpretation; if no supported portal exists, ordering remains manual.

s3 retains original guest-field capture and exceptions in 7 units; only reusing already captured fields is shortened. s4 produces the actual final total and order. a1 binds that version, florist and spending terms after the guest sees it in s5; edits or substitutions require new guest approval.

Florist response produces order_id, acceptance_status and promised_window; s7 checks those facts at full time. Acceptance is not delivery. s9 approves the final guest confirmation before a2, and s11 captures/checks request_id, actual_status and next_action before a3. All final-version changes revoke affected approvals.
research_questions: Can the existing partner route submit only the fully priced guest-approved order and return an explicit acceptance status?

incremental.description: Check florist field mapping, settlement assumptions and status routing

approvals.approved_version: s5 actual final priced order, recipient details and florist
s9 final actual-status guest confirmation and recipient
s11 checked final service-log entry and request ID

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 4.5 catalogue, 3 reuse, 10 submission, 5 confirmation-send and 1 log-save units /90*100 minus 1.5 upkeep = 24.611%, rounded down. Low keeps all but catalogue navigation manual: 4.5/90*100 minus 1.5 = 3.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan special events, parties and meetings, including performer bookings.

steps.what: Clarify the guest's event purpose, budget, timing and practical requirements
Negotiate provisional musician availability, hotel-space holds and supplier quotes
Calculate event option totals using verified quotes and explicit quantities
Prepare the event plan and exact booking messages using native templates
Check the final event plan, total costs, booking terms and recipient details
Approve the actual final event plan, costs and booking commitments
Send the approved musician booking acceptance to the performer contact
Commit the approved hotel event-room booking in the hotel reservation system
Verify actual musician and room booking confirmations and resolve discrepancies
Write and check the final event confirmation for the guest
Send the approved actual-status event confirmation to the guest

tasks.design: For a hotel event with a musician booking, use native {SPREADSHEET} quote totals and {DOCS} plan templates. Preserve guest discovery, supplier negotiation and plan judgement. Obtain approval of the actual completed priced package before separate performer acceptance and room-booking actions in {OTHER}, the hotel reservation system. Verify real confirmations before a separately approved {CHAT} guest send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Provisional availability, a guest's preferred plan and a confirmed event are different states.
tasks.enabler_now: Exact-field templates and existing reservation actions can reduce repeated arithmetic and transfer.
tasks.still_hard: A workable event, reliable suppliers and appropriate performance choices need personal judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the occasion and negotiate a plan the guest and suppliers can deliver.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic and booking-package handling, unchanged negotiation and event judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native quote calculations, document templates and hotel booking records can support a concierge-led event plan; actual system coverage is unverified.

assumptions: Provisional shares contain 90 concierge and 10 guest units. This event has one performer supplier and a hotel room; more suppliers add separately approved actions. No supplier effort or event execution time is claimed as saved.

s1 concierge captures date, guests, purpose, budget and practical_requirements. s2 captures supplier_id, current_quote, quantity, unit_rate, tax, cancellation_terms, availability_window and room_hold from actual replies and hotel records. All negotiating and original data capture stay fully counted.

s3 applies stated quantities and quote terms, not inferred prices. s4 retains plan design, variable wording and exceptions in 14 units; only fixed-field reuse is shortened. Missing quotes require manual confirmation, not guessed totals. Existing formulas/templates earn no new benefit.

s5 checks complete room details, performer acceptance text, total commitments and recipients within the hotel's delegated booking authority. a1/a2 bind this actual guest-approved version after s6; changes or expired holds require new approval. No new payment or deposit automation is credited.

Performer supplies actual acceptance/status; hotel system supplies reservation_status and reference. s9 checks both at full time. s10 writes/checks a concise final status confirmation; a3 binds that finished text and guest contact. Pending never becomes confirmed merely because a message was sent.
unknowns: Current manual quote and template work
research_questions: Can the existing room and message workflows preserve provisional versus confirmed status without extra manual re-entry?

incremental.description: Maintain event quote fields and booking/message mappings

approvals.approved_version: s6 final performer acceptance text, terms and recipient
s6 final room booking, terms and hotel destination
s10 final verified-status confirmation and guest recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 10 calculation, 6 template, 5 performer-send, 3 room-commit and 1 guest-send units /90*100 minus 1 upkeep = 26.778%, rounded down. Low halves calculation only and keeps other steps manual: 5/90*100 minus 1 = 4.556%, rounded down.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use maintained facts and explicit approval states to support personal guest service.
reach: Help hotel teams distinguish requests, approved spending and verified supplier confirmations.
role.ambitious_version: A concierge who offers personal judgement with clear, current information and a reliable record of each guest-approved commitment.
